references.text: Continuation of the instructions for the ark, including gold overlay, carrying poles, and placement of the testimony
Bezalel builds the ark in accordance with the instructions given here, using the same dimensions and materials
Moses makes an ark of acacia wood to store the tablets of the law
Description of the contents of the ark when it was placed in Solomon's temple
David refers to the ark as God's footstool and plans to build a house for it
The letter to the Hebrews describes the ark of the covenant and its contents in connection with the sanctuary of the tabernacle
John sees the ark of the covenant in God's temple in heaven
The description of Bezalel's finished work confirms that the divine instruction was followed with exact precision.
